name: .NET 10 SDK
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'set -e; export PATH=/root/.local/bin:$PATH; mkdir -p /root/.local/bin; if ! command -v omp >/dev/null 2>&1; then curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/can1357/oh-my-pi/main/scripts/install.sh | sh -s -- --binary || true; fi; if command -v omp >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo "omp installed successfully"; else echo "omp installation skipped or failed; you can retry manually"; fi'
